title: Synchronous EEG and fMRI dataset on inner speech
description: This dataset comprises simultaneous EEG-fMRI recordings from 3 subjects across 2 sessions during inner speech tasks. Data were acquired using a 3T MRI scanner and 64-channel BrainProducts EEG system with EEG sampling at 5000 Hz and fMRI TR of 2s. The dataset includes preprocessed EEG data with pulse artifact removal and is organized in BIDS format to facilitate multimodal neuroimaging analysis of inner speech mechanisms. No anatomical MRI data are included in this dataset.
methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a 64-channel BrainProducts system at 5000 Hz sampling rate. fMRI data were acquired on a 3T MRI scanner with TR=2s. EEG preprocessing included pulse artifact removal using BrainVision Analyzer software. The dataset is designated as 'raw' type in BIDS, with preprocessing limited to pulse artifact removal to maintain compliance with raw data standards. Experimental protocol consisted of trials with 2s fixation, 2s stimulus display, and 12s rest periods. Eight words were presented in random order, each repeated 40 times per session.
